violations.description: The executable script tests/test_vortex_admissibility.py is completely unregistered in tool_index.json, tool_manifest.json, and tools_rigor_endorsement_registry.json.

An unregistered Python prototype script was executed to produce campaign evidence under MPF_VORTEX_ADMISSIBILITY_EXECUTION_PATCH_001, violating the campaign spec requirement for the C++ tool triadic_closure_substrate_sim_cpp.
The executed tool lacks any corresponding record or endorsement level in the Rigor Endorsed Tool Registry (tools_rigor_endorsement_registry.json).
Unendorsed custom scoring function and metrics (delta_alpha, organization_score) were implemented inside the test harness without formal registry specification or verification.
